warning: CLASSIFICATION: flood_dataset_classification.csv, flood-positive rows only. Classes are train-only quantiles of people affected, not a surveyed water depth. Rainfall contains repeated filled values. Do not report these metrics as real-world performance.
disclaimer: Academic prediction system for Machine Learning (BIC703), Group G2. This is not an official emergency-warning or evacuation system. Do not use it for operational decisions, alerts, or evacuation.
label_rule: Flood-positive rows only (occured = 1, which matches Disaster Type 0). Total Affected is the score. scripts/train.py bins it with quantiles (0.4, 0.75) fit on the training split only, then drops it. Deaths, affected, disaster type, and occured are not model inputs. training cuts at (3000.0, 55700.0)
objective_reason: Macro F1 weights the three classes equally. Quadratic weighted kappa is reported and is not used to pick the model.

external.note: Feature sets in one population share the spatial cells. Seeds change the spatial split only; the forest seed stays 42. Population B is year >= 2000 with both external sources present. Hyperparameters were chosen on population A training folds and frozen. WorldPop was not downloaded, so population measurements are missing on every row. pop_year_clipped only marks years outside 2000-2020.
